tools.name: manage_cubes
tools.title: Place Cube
tools.description: Creates or updates Bedrock Cubes. Use create for placement, update for one target, batch_update for 1-32 UUID corrections, or simplify for explicit bounds/rotation rounding with dry-run default. Simplify preserves UV/pivots and rejects collapsed axes; it does not reduce Cube count or evaluate visual fidelity.

origin.description: Cube pivot [x,y,z]. Required for non-zero rotation; optional otherwise.

rotation.description: Cube rotation in degrees [x,y,z]; non-zero rotation requires origin.

group.description: Optional per-Cube Group UUID or unique exact-name parent override; use `root` for explicit root. Omit to inherit the top-level group.

inflate.description: Optional finite Bedrock Cube inflation authored at creation.

elements.description: Cubes to place. Each requires finite from/to; rotated Cubes also require origin.

group.description: Optional Group UUID or unique exact name; omit/use `root` only for intentional root placement.

faces.description: UV intent: true/default = inherited project UV mode; explicit rectangles = per-face UV mode.

face.description: Face whose per-face UV rectangle is overridden.

uv.description: Finite custom UV rectangle [u1,v1,u2,v2] for this face.

anyOf.description: Per-face UV overrides; switches the Cube to per-face UV mode; unlisted faces keep their current UV.

id.description: Required Cube UUID or unique exact name; selection is never an implicit target.

origin.description: Cube pivot; origin-only preserves position, with from/to/rotation it rewrites the transform.

rotation.description: Cube rotation; activating non-zero requires origin; already-rotated may reuse its pivot.

autouv.description: Auto UV setting. 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled, 2 = relative auto UV.

uv_offset.description: Finite box-UV offset [u,v] exported by Bedrock when this Cube uses box UV.

face.description: Face whose per-face UV rectangle is overridden.

uv.description: Finite custom UV rectangle [u1,v1,u2,v2] for this face.

faces.description: Per-face UV overrides; switches the Cube to per-face UV mode; unlisted faces keep their current UV.

visibility.description: Whether the cube is visible or not.

id.description: Exact Cube UUID; names and selection are not accepted for batch correction.

origin.description: New pivot. Origin-only preserves visual position; with from/to/rotation it is an authored transform rewrite.

rotation.description: New rotation in degrees. Activating non-zero rotation requires origin; an already-rotated Cube may reuse its pivot.

uv_offset.description: Finite box-UV offset [u,v] for this Cube.

autouv.description: Auto UV setting: 0 disabled, 1 enabled, 2 relative.

face.description: Face whose per-face UV rectangle is overridden.

uv.description: Finite custom UV rectangle [u1,v1,u2,v2] for this face.

faces.description: Per-face UV overrides; switches the Cube to per-face UV mode; unlisted faces keep their current UV.

updates.description: 1-32 explicit Cube transform/Box-UV/visibility updates applied in one Undo unit.

increment.description: Grid increment in model units for bounds, degrees for rotation.

dry_run.description: Return proposed corrections without mutation; false applies one Undo unit. UV and pivots are preserved.

tools.name: capture_screenshot
tools.title: Capture Screenshot
tools.description: Returns the image data of the current editor view. This is a branch-only observation helper when that specific editor view carries evidence that canonical views cannot answer. For normal reference-driven geometry review, prefer `capture_model_views` so framing/orientation are deterministic.

tools.name: capture_app_screenshot
tools.title: Capture App Screenshot
tools.description: Source-preserved generic Blockbench full-application screenshot helper. It is disabled in the normal LazyDesigner Bedrock Entity surface; use `capture_model_views` or `capture_screenshot` for model evidence.

tools.name: set_camera_angle
tools.title: Set Camera Angle
tools.description: Source-preserved generic editor-camera mutation helper. It is disabled in the normal LazyDesigner Bedrock Entity surface because `capture_model_views` provides deterministic observation without mutating the active editor camera.

tools.name: capture_model_views
tools.title: Capture Model Views
tools.description: Captures deterministic labeled square PNG views without changing the active editor camera. Provide explicit views, or evidence_targets plus optional verification_risk. Optional landmark_pairs project rendered Cube centers; optional reference_correspondence attaches current saved recipe-owned Cube identity and provisional source-region associations to the same fresh capture. Both are read-only diagnostics, never solved camera calibration, automatic geometric correction, or visual PASS.

size.description: PNG square size. Omitted: 256/384/512 by evidence_targets detail/risk, else 512. 32-64: icons only.

highlight_missing_textures.description: Temporarily brighten missing-texture materials, then restore. Diagnostic only: no shaded comparison/UI flash.

reference_correspondence.description: Opt-in region→saved recipe Cube UUID candidates. Use current status image metadata. Verify recipe/native identity; PROVISIONAL capture provenance, never visual PASS or mutation.

landmark_pairs.description: Read-only projected Cube-center→image ID/SHA-256 pairs. Explicit views required; no calibration/visual verdict.

views.description: Canonical views; omit for minimum evidence_targets coverage.

evidence_targets.description: Unanswered visual claims. Omitted views deterministically cover these targets.

verification_risk.description: LOW=minimal; MEDIUM=+1 orthogonal; HIGH=front/left/top if possible.

front_direction.description: Explicit object front, no default: prevents mirrored comparison.

animation_preview.description: Optional authored-Animation pose samples; views × times must be ≤8 images.

animation_id.description: Authored Animation UUID or unique exact name.

tools.name: manage_animation_timeline
tools.title: Manage Bedrock Animation Timeline
tools.description: Authors one Bedrock Animation through keyframes, graph/easing, timeline, coherent batch/copy operations, or a one-call native property cohort.

animation_id.description: Animation UUID/name; omit for current animation when supported.

bone_name.description: Group UUID or unique Group name.

time.description: Finite non-negative keyframe time in seconds.

values.description: Authored [x,y,z] or uniform transform value. Each axis may be a finite number or explicit non-empty Molang string; strings are preserved, never evaluated by LazyDesigner.

interpolation.description: Optional interpolation change. Omit on edit to preserve the existing interpolation.

bezier_handles.description: Finite per-axis Bezier handle offsets [x,y,z]; set interpolation=bezier when authoring handles.

animation_id.description: Animation UUID/name; omit for current animation when supported.

bone_name.description: Group UUID or unique Group name.

axis.description: Bezier-handle axis; 'all' applies the same change to x/y/z. Interpolation stays keyframe-level.

action.description: Type of curve modification to apply.

keyframe_range.description: Time range to apply the curve modification. If not provided, applies to all keyframes.

custom_curve.description: Bezier left/right handle offsets for the axis or all axes ('custom' action only).

control_point_1.description: Left Bezier handle offset [time, value]; time must be <= 0.

control_point_2.description: Right Bezier handle offset [time, value]; time must be >= 0.

animation_id.description: Animation UUID/name; omit for current animation when supported.

action.description: Timeline or persistent authored-Animation property action. delete removes an explicit animation_id from this project with Undo, preserving external files.

time.description: Time in seconds for set_time; finite, within Timeline.setTime() range 0..1000, not clamped to animation.length.

length.description: set_length length in seconds; finite, 0..10000. Native setLength() may extend to the keyframe floor.

fps.description: Animation snapping rate in frames per second for set_fps; Blockbench supports 10 to 500.

easing.description: Minecraft Bedrock Entity (bedrock) only. Whole-clip Molang time remapping. Reapply after changing clip length or loop mode. Existing Molang requires replace_existing=true.

bone_ids.description: Explicit bone UUIDs or unique names for expand_bones/collapse_bones, including descendants. View only; expansion shows existing keyed animators.

start.description: Finite non-negative start time in seconds.

end.description: Finite non-negative end time in seconds.

molang.description: Authored Molang for set_anim_time_update/set_blend_weight; null clears to native default. Text normalizes to one line, never evaluated.

interval.description: Finite positive time interval between keyframes.

offset.description: Finite time offset for the pattern.

scale_factor.description: Finite scale factor for keyframe time.

bake_interval.description: Strictly positive finite interval in seconds for baking keyframes.

batch_operation.description: Operation to perform on keyframes. Bake samples each selected animator's full channel range, even with selection=range/pattern subsets.

animation_id.description: Animation UUID/name; omit for current animation when supported.

bone.description: Exact source Group UUID or exact unique Group name.

channels.description: One or more animation channels to copy.

time_range.description: Time range to copy. If not provided, copies all keyframes.

bone.description: Exact target Group UUID or exact unique Group name.

time_offset.description: Finite time offset for pasted keyframes.

mirror_axis.description: Axis to mirror across for mirror_paste.

animation_id.description: Animation UUID/name; omit for current animation when supported.

bone_name.description: Group UUID or unique Group name.

relative_to.description: Bedrock rotation space. entity exports relative_to.rotation=entity.

tools.name: create_animation
tools.title: Create Bedrock Animation Clip
tools.description: Creates one new authored Bedrock Animation clip with explicit bone transforms and optional initial sound/particle effects. Use this for a new clip, not project creation.

bones.description: Bone keyframes keyed by Group UUID or case-insensitively unique name; values use authored space.

locator.description: Optional Locator name for the particle.
Optional Locator name for the particle.

particle_effects.description: Particle effects keyed by non-negative timestamps.

sound_effects.description: Sound effects keyed by non-negative timestamps.

tools.name: bone_rigging
tools.title: Bone Rigging
tools.description: Advanced/compatibility rig operations. Normal hierarchy mutation uses add_group, modify_group, reparent_element, rename_element, and remove_element. Prefer bone_rigging only for IK or bone mirroring. Blockbench 5.2+ native IK controller target/root/pole settings are handled by set_ik_controller without adding another capability; legacy overlapping actions remain for compatibility.

action.description: Action to perform on the bone structure.

name.description: Required for every action except set_ik_controller. Create: new name. Other actions: Group UUID or unique name.

parent.description: Parent Group UUID or unique name.

rotation.description: Initial create rotation; omit for neutral zero rotation.

children.description: Create-only child UUIDs or unique exact names; all are preflighted.

ik_enabled.description: Enable inverse kinematics for this bone.

ik_target.description: Existing target Group UUID or exact unique name for legacy bone IK.

controller.description: Blockbench 5.2+ native IK controller Null Object UUID or unique exact name.

controller_target.description: Blockbench 5.2+ IK target node UUID/name; null clears the target.

controller_source.description: Blockbench 5.2+ IK root/source node UUID/name; null clears the source.

controller_pole.description: Blockbench 5.2+ IK pole Group/Locator/Null Object UUID/name; null clears the pole.

lock_ik_target_rotation.description: Blockbench 5.2+ native IK controller target-rotation lock.

mirror_axis.description: Axis required by mirror; no implicit mirror axis is assumed.

tools.name: manage_animation_effects
tools.title: Manage Animation Effects
tools.description: Adds, updates, or removes existing-Animation particle, sound, and timeline effect keyframes with exact keyframe/data-point identity, preflighted collisions, one Undo transaction, and bounded continuation state.

animation_id.description: Animation UUID/name; omit for current animation when supported.

operations.description: Ordered bounded effect mutations for one authored Animation.

tools.name: manage_animation_controller
tools.title: Manage Animation Controller
tools.description: Creates/updates Bedrock AnimationControllers plus bounded client-entity animation/Molang runtime wiring, public/init/pre-animation scripts, scale, and controller variables without adding another tool.

controller_id.description: Existing controller UUID or unique name.

state.description: Exact state UUID or unique exact state name.

id.description: Exact transition, animation-link, sound, or particle UUID.

name.description: Controller/state name for rename or add_state.

blend_value.description: Finite number or authored Molang blend value.

locator.description: Particle Locator name; null clears to entity space.

bind_to_actor.description: Particle actor binding; null resets to native default true.

tools.name: inspect_particle
tools.title: Inspect Bedrock Particle
tools.description: Inspects a Bedrock .particle.json document from an absolute path or inline content. Diagnostics use the repository current-stable compatibility catalog; they do not by themselves prove exact target-version field/default availability. Defaults to compact summary diagnostics; component and full modes are explicit to keep context usage bounded.

tools.name: manage_particle
tools.title: Manage Bedrock Particle
tools.description: Creates or losslessly patches a Bedrock .particle.json document, preserves unknown JSON fields, validates against the repository current-stable compatibility catalog, optionally performs a verified transactional file write, and can load the particle into Blockbench's native preview. New creation requires an explicit texture reference. Missing custom particle bitmaps route through existing create_texture + paint tools and finalize through paint_texture_transaction PNG output; manage_particle never duplicates texture authoring. Downstream runtime binding remains owned by existing animation/controller tools.

preset.description: Bootstrap convenience only. Preset numeric values are editable starting points, not canonical visual or production defaults.

operations.description: Ordered targeted particle mutations. Use patch for deep edits without replacing unknown sibling fields.

path.description: Path relative to particle_effect, for targeted lossless edits.

texture_dependency.description: Optional texture provenance/handoff metadata. New particle creation still requires an explicit final texture reference in create.texture or set_render; generated state=missing routes the bitmap dependency to existing Texturing.

texture.description: Bedrock texture reference already available to the resource pack.
Vanilla Bedrock texture reference reused without authoring a new bitmap.

output_path.description: Absolute final PNG path. It must end with the same textures/particle/... path declared by texture.

name.description: Texture name passed to the existing create_texture capability.

description.description: Compact visual brief for the existing Texturing paint pipeline.

preview.description: Load the resulting document through Blockbench Animator.loadParticleEmitter using an existing source path or verified output path.

tools.name: inspect_animation
tools.title: Inspect Animation Clip or Controller
tools.description: Inspects authored Bedrock Animation clips or AnimationControllers. Use bone for focused authored-bone transforms, state for focused controller-state detail, and include_effect_keyframes only when full authored Animation effects are required.

animation_id.description: Exact Animation/AnimationController UUID or unique name; omit to use the selected AnimationItem.

bone.description: Optional Group UUID or unique exact name. Use only for authored Animation bone/keyframe detail.

state.description: Optional controller state UUID or unique exact name for focused state-machine detail.

include_effect_keyframes.description: Include full particle/sound/timeline effect keyframes; keep false for summary.

channel.description: Optional transform channel filter for focused bone inspection. Requires bone.

time_range.description: Optional inclusive keyframe time range for focused bone inspection. Requires bone.

diagnostics.description: Include compact authored-Animation technical diagnostics. No visual quality score is produced.

tools.name: inspect_elements
tools.title: Inspect Elements
tools.description: Inspects Bedrock elements through one focused boundary. Use mode=outline for hierarchy, search for bounded criteria discovery, or detail for one authored element with optional UV data.

include_cubes.description: If true, include cubes as leaves. If false, return groups only.

max_depth.description: Maximum tree depth. Default 8; increase only for deeper structure.

max_nodes.description: Maximum Cube/Group nodes returned. Default 120; raise explicitly when truncation matters.

name_pattern.description: Optional non-empty case-sensitive name regex; invalid/oversized/unsafe patterns are rejected.

name_contains.description: Optional non-empty substring to match element names. Case-insensitive.

type.description: Restrict to Cube or Group results.

parent_group.description: Optional Group UUID or unique exact name whose descendant subtree scopes results.

limit.description: Maximum results. Default 50; increase only when the search genuinely needs more.

id.description: Exact Cube, Group, Locator, or Null Object UUID, or exact unique name; prefer UUID after discovery.

detail.description: Geometry transform by default; request `uv` only when UV mapping needs inspection.

tools.name: remove_element
tools.title: Remove Element
tools.description: Removes one explicit Cube, Group, or outliner target with Undo support.

id.description: Exact element UUID or exact unique name. Ambiguous names are rejected before removal.

tools.name: add_group
tools.title: Add Group
tools.description: Adds one or more Bedrock Groups/bones with optional parent, pivot, and rotation.

origin.description: Finite Bedrock bone pivot/origin; omit for organizational Groups unless a joint/attachment needs it.

rotation.description: Finite initial Bedrock bone rotation; omit for neutral zero rotation.

parent.description: Parent Group UUID or unique exact name; omit/use `root` for intentional root.

groups.description: Coherent non-empty Group/bone batch; ordered, one Undo unit.

rotation.description: Finite initial rotation; omit for zero.

parent.description: Parent Group UUID/name or `root`; may reference an earlier batch entry.

tools.name: duplicate_element
tools.title: Duplicate Element
tools.description: Duplicates one explicit Cube/Group with optional offset and root name.

id.description: Exact Cube or Group UUID, or exact unique name. Ambiguous names are rejected before duplication.

offset.description: Finite translation offset [x,y,z] applied to the duplicated Cube/Group subtree.

newName.description: Name for the duplicated root only; descendants keep `<name>_copy` names.

tools.name: rename_element
tools.title: Rename Element
tools.description: Renames one explicit outliner target via id/new_name, or up to 128 Groups via updates of UUID/new_name. Group batches preview by default (dry_run); false applies one Undo and synchronizes animation references. Final names must be unique case-insensitively.

id.description: Exact element/Group UUID or unique name; ambiguous names are rejected before rename.

dry_run.description: Preview Group batch rename; false applies names and animation references in one Undo.

tools.name: select_all_of_type
tools.title: Select All of Type
tools.description: Selects all Cubes or Groups of one type for workflows that require editor selection.

add_to_selection.description: If true, add to current selection. If false, replace Cube/Group selection.

parent_group.description: Optional Group UUID/unique-name subtree scope; rejected if ambiguous before selection.

tools.name: filter_by_material
tools.title: Filter Elements by Material
tools.description: Legacy raw face-material lookup. Disabled on the Bedrock Entity surface.

texture.description: Explicit texture reference for read-only Cube material discovery. UUID is preferred, then exact texture ID, then exact name only when unique. Ambiguous IDs or names are rejected.

include_face_keys.description: Include the list of cube face keys (e.g., 'north') that reference the texture.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.title: Get Selection
tools.description: Returns current Cube/Group selection and active Texture when editor selection matters.

tools.name: modify_group
tools.title: Modify Group
tools.description: Modifies one explicit Bedrock Group pivot, rotation, visibility, or translates its subtree using offset. Use rename_element for names.

id.description: Exact Group UUID or unique exact name.

offset.description: Translate Group subtree in authored model coordinates, including bounds/pivots/anchors. Use alone; preserves UV and animation keys. Not a camera-relative drag.

tools.name: reparent_element
tools.title: Reparent Element
tools.description: Moves one explicit Cube or Group to a new parent. Rejects self/circular hierarchy; local transform is preserved.

id.description: Exact Cube or Group UUID or unique exact name.

parent.description: New parent Group UUID or unique exact name; use `root` for root placement.

tools.name: list_locator_elements
tools.title: List Bedrock Locator Elements
tools.description: Lists Locator/Null Object identity, type, and parent. Use inspect_elements(mode=detail) for detailed authored state.

tools.name: manage_locator
tools.title: Manage Bedrock Locator
tools.description: Creates or updates a Locator. Create requires name+parent; update requires id plus an authored field. For a moving attachment/reference point, parent the Locator to the animated Group/Bone; current animation tools keyframe Groups/Bones, not Locator elements directly. Rename/delete use rename_element/remove_element.

parent.description: Required when action=create. Parent Group UUID or unique exact name.

action.description: Update: requires id + at least one authored field; omit name.

id.description: Required when action=update. Locator UUID or unique exact name.

parent.description: Replacement parent Group UUID or unique exact name.

tools.name: manage_null_object
tools.title: Manage Bedrock Null Object
tools.description: Creates or updates a Null Object. Create requires name+parent; update requires id plus parent/position. Geometry uses a `_null_` locator entry; IK fields remain Blockbench editor/animation state. Rename/delete use rename_element/remove_element.

name.description: Required when action=create. Null Object name.

parent.description: Required when action=create. Parent Group UUID or unique exact name.

action.description: Update: requires id plus parent and/or position; omit name.

id.description: Required when action=update. Null Object UUID or unique exact name.

parent.description: Replacement parent Group UUID or unique exact name.

tools.name: list_export_formats
tools.title: List LazyDesigner Model Outputs
tools.description: Lists native Bedrock geometry and editable project codecs plus content-only Bedrock animation compilation through AnimationCodec. Does not enumerate arbitrary registered codecs or export animation controllers.

tools.name: export_model
tools.title: Export Bedrock Model
tools.description: Compiles Bedrock geometry JSON or editable `.bbmodel` with verified filesystem writes. `bedrock_animation` uses native AnimationCodec for all authored clips and returns JSON content only; omit path/options and persist the returned content separately. Project overwrite requires consent; existing geometry files are refused.

codec_id.description: LazyDesigner output: `bedrock` = geometry JSON, `project` = editable `.bbmodel`, `bedrock_animation` = native AnimationCodec JSON returned as content only (no path/options).

options.description: Optional compile options for the selected Bedrock/project codec.

path.description: Optional absolute output path; requires Blockbench filesystem permission.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing `.bbmodel` at `path`; Bedrock exports always refuse existing files.

max_content_length.description: Max characters returned in `content`; default 0 with `path`, else 100000.

tools.name: undo
tools.title: Undo
tools.description: Undoes recent edits. Use `steps` to undo multiple edits in one call; returns the actions undone.

tools.name: redo
tools.title: Redo
tools.description: Redoes recently undone edits. Use `steps` to redo multiple edits in one call; returns the actions redone.

tools.name: get_undo_stack
tools.title: Get Undo Stack
tools.description: Returns bounded recent undo/redo history and checkpoints for actual recovery/navigation; it should not be polled between successful bounded edits.

limit.description: Maximum recent entries returned. Defaults to 20; increase explicitly for deeper recovery history.

tools.name: save_checkpoint
tools.title: Save Checkpoint
tools.description: Adds a named Undo marker before meaningful risky rework. Do not create a checkpoint after every Cube/edit; normal bounded edits already participate in Undo.

name.description: Descriptive checkpoint name shown in undo history for navigation back to this point.

tools.name: from_geo_json
tools.title: Import GeoJSON
tools.description: Imports a model from a GeoJSON file.

geojson.description: Path to the GeoJSON file or data URL, or the GeoJSON string itself.

tools.name: manage_material_instances
tools.title: Manage Material Instances
tools.description: Lists, reads, assigns, bulk-assigns, or clears Bedrock face material instances through one focused boundary.

include_usages.description: Include Cube/face usage locations. Keep false for summary-only discovery.

usage_limit_per_instance.description: Maximum usage locations returned per material instance when include_usages=true.

cube_id.description: Exact Cube UUID or exact unique Cube name. If omitted, uses the first selected Cube.

faces.description: Specific non-empty face set to get/clear. If omitted, uses all faces.

cube_id.description: Exact Cube UUID or exact unique Cube name. If omitted, applies to all selected Cubes.

material_name.description: The material instance name to assign. Use empty string to clear the material instance.

faces.description: Faces to set the material instance on. Defaults to all faces.
Non-empty faces to set the material instance on.

cube_id.description: Exact Cube UUID or exact unique Cube name. If omitted, clears from all selected Cubes.

faces.description: Specific faces to clear. If not provided, clears all faces.

all_cubes.description: If true, clears material instances from all cubes in the project.

tools.name: paint_fill_tool
tools.title: Paint Fill Tool
tools.description: Uses the fill/bucket tool to fill areas with color.

tools.name: draw_shape_tool
tools.title: Draw Shape Tool
tools.description: Draws geometric shapes on textures.

shape.description: Shape to draw. '_h' suffix means hollow.

tools.name: gradient_tool
tools.title: Gradient Tool
tools.description: Applies gradients to textures.

tools.name: color_picker_tool

tools.description: Picks a color into the active color slot; pick_opacity also mutates brush opacity state.

y.description: Y coordinate to pick color from.

tools.name: copy_brush_tool

y.description: Source Y coordinate to copy from.

pick_color_opacity.description: Pick opacity when using color picker.

connect_strokes.description: Whether to connect paint strokes with lines.

softness_pressure_curve.description: Four normalized Bezier [pressure,value] pairs. Requires active Brush Tuna and stylus pressure when loaded; does not affect exact pixel transactions.

opacity_pressure_curve.description: Four normalized Bezier [pressure,value] pairs. Requires active Brush Tuna and stylus pressure when loaded; does not affect exact pixel transactions.

tools.description: Loads and applies a brush preset by name. Pressure curves require active Brush Tuna and stylus input; presets do not control exact pixel transactions.

preset_name.description: Name of the brush preset to load.

tools.name: texture_selection
tools.title: Texture Selection

tools.name: texture_layer_management
tools.title: Texture Layer Management
tools.description: Mutates texture layers with explicit identity and scoped Undo.

tools.name: paint_texture_transaction
tools.title: Paint Texture Transaction

color.description: Color as hex string (#RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA, e.g., #FF0000).
Color as hex string (#RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA, e.g., #FF0000).

tools.name: create_project
tools.title: Create Project
tools.description: Creates a new Minecraft Bedrock Entity project in Blockbench's native `bedrock` format; refuses unsaved work without `discard_unsaved`.

discard_unsaved.description: Discard unsaved changes in the open project; required when it currently has unsaved work.

tools.name: get_project_info
tools.title: Get Project Info
tools.description: Returns project lifecycle, format, logical UV resolution, and element counts. Use inspect_elements(mode=outline) only when hierarchy detail is needed.

tools.name: inspect_model_bounds
tools.title: Inspect Model Bounds
tools.description: Returns rendered-current-pose Cube bounds, visibility counts, and pose context. Observation only; no visual PASS/FAIL.

tools.name: switch_authoring_phase
tools.title: switch_authoring_phase
tools.description: Changes the Authoring Stage in the same task. Geometry↔Texturing stays on the shared AUTHORING Runtime Surface; AUTHORING↔Animation is the only Runtime Surface handoff. Animation requires a saved checkpoint, UV Layout PASS, no blockers, and either explicit user Geometry+Texture approval or explicitly authorized autonomous verification with current-revision evidence. Internal diagnostic PASS never equals user approval.

checkpoint.description: Saved .bbmodel checkpoint path; records explicit user approval, never inferred by the caller.

autonomous_authorized.description: User explicitly authorized autonomous execution; never infer this from tool availability.

evidence.description: Current-revision geometry/texture evidence and readiness summary; not a user-approval claim.

tools.name: manage_render_profile
tools.title: Manage Render Profile
tools.description: Inspects or authors Minecraft Entity render_profile bindings across client_entity material slots and ordered render-controller bone assignments. This is separate from PBR manage_material and geometry material instances.

tools.name: manage_material
tools.title: Manage Material
tools.description: Creates, configures, assigns channels, or saves one Bedrock PBR material through one focused boundary.

color_texture.description: Optional color Texture UUID, exact ID, or unique exact name.

normal_texture.description: Optional normal Texture UUID, exact ID, or unique exact name.

height_texture.description: Optional height Texture UUID, exact ID, or unique exact name.

mer_texture.description: Optional MER Texture UUID, exact ID, or unique exact name.

color_value.description: Uniform RGBA color [R,G,B,A] when no color texture is provided.

mer_value.description: Uniform MER values [Metalness, Emissive, Roughness] (0-255) when no MER texture is provided.

subsurface_value.description: Subsurface scattering value (0-255) for Bedrock 1.21.30+ materials.

material.description: Required material/TextureGroup UUID or unique exact name.

color_texture.description: Color Texture UUID/ID/unique name, or `none` for uniform color.

normal_texture.description: Normal Texture UUID/ID/unique name, or `none` to remove.

height_texture.description: Height Texture UUID/ID/unique name, or `none` to remove.

mer_texture.description: MER Texture UUID/ID/unique name, or `none` for uniform values.

color_value.description: Uniform RGBA color [R,G,B,A] when no color texture.

material.description: Material/texture group target for channel assignment; UUID preferred, exact name only when unique.

texture.description: Explicit texture target; UUID preferred, then texture ID, then unique name.

channel.description: PBR channel to assign the texture to.

material.description: Material/texture group target to save; UUID preferred, exact name only when unique.

tools.name: create_texture
tools.title: Create Texture
tools.description: Creates a texture and returns compact metadata. Use get_texture only when image data is needed.

texture_id.description: Existing base atlas UUID for template repack or resize.

type.description: Texture creation mode. Template builds UV layout from model geometry before any pixel painting.

pixel_density.description: Template density in pixels per 16 model units. At 16x, one model unit maps to one texture pixel.

rearrange_uv.description: Repack UVs; false with texture_id resizes matching atlases at pixel_density, retaining logical UVs and UUIDs.

power_of_two.description: Round the generated template atlas to a power-of-two square.

keep_multi_texture_occupancy.description: Reuse identical existing UV occupancy when generating a template.

padding.description: Reserve a one-pixel padding border around template islands.

data.description: Image data URL or deterministic absolute image file path.

group.description: Optional TextureGroup UUID or unique exact name.

fill_color.description: RGBA color to fill the texture, as tuple or HEX string.

layer_name.description: Non-empty texture layer name. Required if fill_color is set.

pbr_channel.description: PBR channel: color, normal, height, or MER.

render_sides.description: Render sides for the texture. Auto, front, or double.

source_texture_id.description: Established base-color atlas UUID/ID/unique exact name to duplicate.

group.description: Explicit non-material TextureGroup UUID or unique exact name for the variant.

tools.name: apply_texture
tools.title: Apply Texture
tools.description: Legacy per-face texture wrapper. Disabled on the normal Bedrock Entity surface; use activate_texture.

id.description: Required Cube/Group UUID or unique exact name.

texture.description: Required Texture UUID, exact ID, or unique exact name.

applyTo.description: Apply texture to element or group.

tools.name: add_texture_group
tools.title: Add Texture Group
tools.description: Adds a uniquely named TextureGroup.

textures.description: Optional non-empty explicit texture targets; each resolves UUID, then texture ID, then unique name.

is_material.description: Whether the texture group is a PBR material or not.

tools.name: list_textures
tools.title: List Textures
tools.description: Lists texture identity. Default diagnostics=false returns inventory only. diagnostics=true enables bounded review selected by diagnostic_scope; full preserves combined UV/coverage/seam/PBR diagnostics. Technical readiness is not visual approval.

diagnostics.description: Opt in to bounded diagnostics. false returns texture inventory only; true enables diagnostics selected by diagnostic_scope.

diagnostic_scope.description: Used only when diagnostics=true. full preserves the legacy combined UV/coverage/seam/PBR review.

tools.name: get_texture
tools.title: Get Texture
tools.description: Returns image data for the selected or explicitly identified texture.

expected_revision.description: Full decoded-RGBA texture revision returned by LazyDesigner.

render_profile.description: Optional Vanilla render intent for interpreting alpha in this evidence region. Use minecraft_material_code instead for custom materials.

minecraft_material_code.description: Optional literal Minecraft entity material code for render-aware alpha interpretation.

tools.name: list_materials
tools.title: List Materials
tools.description: Lists all PBR materials (texture groups with is_material=true) and their assigned textures per channel.

tools.name: get_material_info
tools.title: Get Material Info
tools.description: Returns detailed metadata for one PBR material, including its Bedrock texture-set preview.

material.description: Material/texture group target to inspect; UUID preferred, exact name only when unique.

tools.name: import_texture_set
tools.title: Import Texture Set
tools.description: Imports one Bedrock texture_set.json and returns the created material identity.

path.description: Absolute path to the .texture_set.json file to import.

tools.name: activate_texture
tools.title: Activate Texture
tools.description: Activates one texture for subsequent paint operations.

texture.description: Texture target to activate; UUID preferred, then ID, then unique name.

tools.name: trigger_action
tools.title: Trigger Action
tools.description: Triggers an action in the Blockbench editor.

action.description: Action ID from Blockbench's BarItems registry.

confirmDialog.description: Whether or not to automatically confirm any dialogs that appear as a result of the action.

tools.name: risky_eval
tools.title: Eval
tools.description: Evaluates the given expression and logs it to the console. Do not pass `console` commands as they will not work.

code.description: JavaScript code to evaluate. Do not pass `console` commands or comments.

tools.name: emulate_clicks
tools.title: Emulate Clicks
tools.description: Emulates clicks on the given interface elements.

drag.description: Drag options. If set, will perform a drag from position to 'to'.

duration.description: Duration of the drag in milliseconds.

tools.name: fill_dialog
tools.title: Fill Dialog
tools.description: Fills the dialog with the given values.

values.description: Stringified form of values to fill the dialog with.

confirm.description: Whether to confirm or cancel the dialog after filling it. True to confirm, false to cancel.

prompts.name: bedrock_entity_workflow
prompts.title: Minecraft Bedrock Entity Workflow
prompts.description: Compact LazyDesigner workflow for Bedrock Entity authoring: minimum evidence, visual gates, bounded correction, downstream readiness, protected native gaps, and Bedrock/.bbmodel export.

resources.name: particle-reference
resources.title: Bedrock Particle Reference
resources.description: Lazy reference for Bedrock particle component families, render materials, compact starting presets, particle Molang/math, and authoring workflow. Read only the section needed for the current particle decision.

resources.name: projects
resources.title: Blockbench Projects
resources.description: Browse Blockbench project metadata by stable resource URI. Use focused project tools when a modelling decision needs current operational state rather than browsing context.

resources.name: nodes
resources.title: Blockbench Nodes
resources.description: Broad read-only Blockbench node observability retained for native gaps such as TextureMesh. It is not a focused authored-state owner; prefer dedicated inspection tools when available.

resources.name: textures
resources.title: Blockbench Textures
resources.description: Browse Texture metadata by URI. This resource does not return raw image/source payload; use `get_texture` when image data is actually needed.

resources.name: reference_models
resources.title: Reference Models
resources.description: Returns information about reference models in the current Blockbench project. Requires the Reference Models plugin. List URIs use the slugified name (e.g. `reference-models://turntable`) when unique, with a `~<uuid-prefix>` suffix on collision. Reads also accept the raw UUID or exact name.

resources.name: validator-status
resources.title: Validator Status
resources.description: Returns the current validation status. Any elementRefs are best-effort message-text inferences and are explicitly marked non-authoritative.

resources.name: validator-checks
resources.title: Validator Checks
resources.description: Returns information about registered validator checks. Use without an ID to list all checks, or provide a check ID to get details about a specific check.

resources.name: validator-warnings
resources.title: Validator Warnings
resources.description: Returns current validation warnings. Any elementRefs are best-effort message-text inferences and are explicitly marked non-authoritative.

resources.name: validator-errors
resources.title: Validator Errors
resources.description: Returns current validation errors. Any elementRefs are best-effort message-text inferences and are explicitly marked non-authoritative.

resources.name: texture-authoring-knowledge
resources.title: Texture Authoring Knowledge
resources.description: On-demand LazyDesigner texture treatment knowledge: surface-pattern recipes, Vanilla pixel/render principles, known entity render profiles, and treatment-plan structure. Read only the topic needed for the current texture decision.
